Chapter 02

Write

Essays on the Substack, mostly about the systems around us: school, AI, and the machines that hold our work.

The Grade That Lied What a report card doesn't tell you about the person holding it. 2026 AI in the Classroom Where AI actually helps in school, and where it quietly does the work for you. 2026 The RAM Crisis How AI ate the world's memory, and why your next computer costs more. 2026

Order first. Then the interesting part.

I'm Stephen, fifteen, working out of New Jersey. I build websites, stores and games, and I write essays about the systems they live inside. Two habits run through everything I make: it has to load fast, and it has to feel like a person made it.

The ink on this page is doing the talking for now. Hold it, scatter it, let it settle. That's most of building: make a mess, then make it mean something.
